title: AI x UX Mini Hackathon, Designing Smarter, Together
excerpt: Last Saturday, I participated in a AI x UX mini hackathon focused on exploring how designers can enhance creativity, make better design decisions, and thoughtfully integrate AI into their workflow, beyond the usual AI noise.

title: UXDX Product Design Meetup at the Empire State Building
excerpt: My experience with meeting wonderful group of industry leaders and reflections on AI, Leadership, and the Future of Design. An evening that was not only inspiring but also a reminder of how vibrant and forward-thinking the design community has become.

title: From Data Annotation to AI Insights: My Journey at Nepasoft LLC
excerpt: Reflection on my 1.5 year working as a data annotator to grow my understanding of Machine learning. As a product designer, it was my greatest desire to learn not just how AI can be used, but how AI systems are built and who the people are behind them.

title: Why Doing Nothing Boosts Productivity by 200%
excerpt: How to be more productive by doing nothing. Most people think productivity is about discipline and logic: make a plan, follow the steps, check the boxes. But I've learned something deeper—it's not logic that fuels creative work, it's emotion.
